notes.title: Patreon Launched
notes.content:
I have just launched our Patreon! Read below what will be included.

[b]What you get[/b]
New shiny role in discord @Patreon Backer 
Weekly updates with screenshots (videos where possible)
News and updates as much as 3 times a week
Be in a monthly draw for FREE Steam Keys!
Have that nice feeling that you are supporting the development of the game

[b]What will it cost?[/b]
I have just one tier and that is £1 per month, I have kept this as low as possible as it is just to aid the development of the game.
I may look at more tiers when the game is ready for some sort of release as this game will NOT be locked to selling on steam only!

[b]Where will the money go?[/b]
I will be using the Patreon money to carry on development, it will help pay for me to carry on full time developing this game and also to help pay for assets or freelancers to help on aspects of the game.

[b]Where can we support?[/b]
You can show your support and get the latest news on the following link.
[b]Patreon link:[/b]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/OvalRacerSeries]https://www.patreon.com/OvalRacerSeries[/url]
